preconditions.description: The length of str1 must be between 1 and 100.
The length of str2 must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str1)
preconditions.description: All characters in str1 must be one of '*', '#', or '@'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str2)
preconditions.description: All characters in str2 must be one of '*', '#', or '@'.

postconditions.description: The number of bridges built must be non-negative.
The number of bridges built cannot exceed the length of the shorter string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len([c for c in str1 if c in str2])
postconditions.description: The number of bridges built is equal to the number of matching characters between str1 and str2.
